_comment: Editorial content for PACE. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. Deliberately no product list: no project list was verifiable from the company's own site. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility was available, and a generic stock photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Pace (Pakistan) Limited is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, in the property sector. Its stated objects are to build, acquire, manage and sell condominiums, departmental stores, shopping plazas, supermarkets, utility stores, housing societies, plots and other properties, and to carry on related commercial and industrial activities in and outside Pakistan.
headOffice: First Capital House, 96-B/1, Lower Ground Floor, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
